hypothesis: A pixel-wise fault probability built from label-free geophysical bands (strain-rate magnitude, gravity+magnetics gradient magnitude, surface conductivity, earthquake density) of training_features.tif ranks geothermal structural zones higher than background; it targets physical proxies of active faulting/fluid flow rather than USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue membership, so it can surface faults missing from the catalogue.
mechanism: Locate feature bands by description metadata; percentile-normalize each band to [0,1] on valid pixels; average bands; mild contrast (x^1.25); write NaN where features are null. Single-band float32 GeoTIFF, EPSG:32611, 100 m, values in [0,1].
named_non_fault_mimic: Lithologic or stratigraphic boundaries can produce gravity/magnetic/conductivity contrasts and localized strain without displacement (false positives).
